title: half-state-patrol: the "Live half-state sweep" PR job now runs past its 15-minute cap
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwhy7iXYvfs2NorugV

Filing category: ③ maintainer's direct order. The maintainer, on a decision card in the skills seat thread, 2026-11-13 (verbatim): 「破例先合,另立卡修超时」 — land PR #32962 as an exception and file a card to fix the timeout.

## What is broken

`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` runs only on `pull_request` (paths filter on the patrol's own files), with `timeout-minutes: 15` on the sweep job. Its job `Live half-state sweep` was cancelled at that cap on both heads of PR #32962 (runs 43341371697 and 43345004879), in the step "Sweep the board and update the anchor", with no output. The PR changed only string literals and comments in `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, and the script's own self-test battery was green in `Lint · repo & tooling gates`.

The last ten successful runs of this workflow (2026-11-05 to 2026-11-09) took 6.5 to 11.5 minutes and trend upward. Inference, not measured: the live board the sweep reads has grown past what 15 minutes covers. The relay cannot re-run this workflow (its rerun fence allows only `ci.yml` and `check-links.yml`).

## Business reason

The sweep is the only live proof, on a real runner, that a change to the half-state patrol still renders its board. Every later PR that touches the patrol's trigger paths will hit the same wall and leave a cancelled check, which the landing rule ("every check green") does not accept, so each one would need the same maintainer exception.

## Who acts

Triage routes it (the file is `.github/workflows/**`, PM tooling). The fix is either a larger cap measured against a fresh full-board run, or a sweep that reads less of the board on a `pull_request` run. Either is a governed workflow change.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open "Live half-state sweep"`: 2 hits, neither about the timeout (#9857 is the patrol's generated view, #9831 a seat post). `is:issue "half-state-patrol" timeout`: 72 hits, the top five all closed and unrelated.
